_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: WU-<recordNo>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

productionOrderName.description: Display value of productionOrderId, copied from u_mes_exe_productionOrder.recordNo

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prd_item.description

productVariantName.description: Display value of productVariantId, copied from u_mes_prd_productVariant.name

serialNumberName.description: Display value of serialNumberId, copied from u_mes_trc_serialNumber.recordNo

bodyLotName.description: Display value of bodyLotId, copied from u_mes_exe_lot.recordNo

routingName.description: Display value of routingId, copied from u_mes_prd_routing.description

currentOperationName.description: Display value of currentOperationId, copied from u_mes_prd_operation.name

currentWorkCenterId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_workCenter._id: current work center

currentWorkCenterName.description: Display value of currentWorkCenterId, copied from u_mes_mdm_workCenter.name

qualityHoldName.description: Display value of qualityHoldId, copied from u_mes_qlt_qualityHold.recordNo

createdAtOperationId.description: Reference to u_mes_prd_operation._id: created at operation

createdAtOperationName.description: Display value of createdAtOperationId, copied from u_mes_prd_operation.name

startedAt.description: Date and time when the record was started

completedAt.description: Date and time when the record was completed

lastOperationExecutionId.description: Reference to u_mes_exe_operationExecution._id: last operation execution

lastOperationExecutionName.description: Display value of lastOperationExecutionId, copied from u_mes_exe_operationExecution.recordNo

containerName.description: Display value of containerId, copied from u_mes_exe_container.recordNo

castDateCode.description: Date, shift and cavity code cast into the body

scrappedAt.description: Date and time when the record was scrapped

shippedAt.description: Date and time when the record was shipped

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mdm_user.fullName
